paragraphs: Rav Papa, son of Rav Chanan of Bei Kluchit, or Tzluchit.
Mentioned in Ketubot 40b, speaking before Rav Shimi bar Ashi.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: The heading supplies Bei Kluchit or Tzluchit as alternatives; their conventional vowels do not establish a geographic identification.
מ: gives Ketubot 40b under the colon convention, without independent named-edition verification.
Papa speaks before Rav Shimi bar Ashi, not the reverse. All three separate Rav titles are full; the final Ashi patronymic has no separate title and gains none.
